# Asset sources and licenses — Terrace & Rose

**Third-party assets used: none.** Every runtime asset is original to this project. Each one is generated by
`tools/blender/build_assets.py` (Blender 4.2 LTS, GPL tool; its *output* belongs to this project) or built in code.
These assets are released with the project under CC0 1.0 unless the project owner picks another license.

| Asset | Path | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| Avatar bodies (shared rig, 3 frames), hair, outfits, accessories, 10 animations | `assets/models/avatars/*.glb` | `build_assets.py` → `assets/source/avatar_*.blend` | Original (CC0) |
| Furniture: chair, table, bed, prep counter, lamp, rug, plant, shelf | `assets/models/furniture/*.glb` | `build_assets.py` → `assets/source/furniture_and_building.blend` | Original (CC0) |
| Building modules: door frame, door leaf, window, porch arch, brass pendant | `assets/models/building/*.glb` | same as above | Original (CC0) |
| Walls, floors, roof, fence, garden beds | built at runtime | `scripts/view/world_view.gd` | Original (CC0) |
| Textures (walnut, stucco, fabric, knit, hair, skin, tile, grass, path, roof, rug) | `assets/textures/*.png` | Procedural numpy, `build_assets.py` | Original (CC0) |
| Audio (coastal ambience, UI click/error, chime, knock, coins, sizzle) | `assets/audio/*.wav` | Synthesised, `build_assets.py` | Original (CC0) |
| UI theme, icon | `scripts/ui/ui_theme.gd`, `icon.svg` | Hand-authored | Original (CC0) |
| Font | Godot's built-in default font | Bundled with the Godot engine | Engine-provided (MIT/OFL, see Godot license) |

When adding any third-party asset, add a row with the exact source URL, author, license, and date retrieved.
